commits.message:
A transposed text-<role> turns as far as its role does, and a test says so (rich-unfiled-791c.0ny5) (#524)

* A transposed text-<role> turns as far as its role does, and a test says so (rich-unfiled-791c.0ny5)

#522 made rootOf read past a drawn-on prefix, which fixed the reported
bug, but pinned only isAnchored. Nothing asserted what transposePalette
draws, so the behaviour a consumer sees could break with the suite green.

The new test covers every accent role and goes red for text-success,
text-warning and text-error when the prefix handling is removed.
docs/transpose.md still called the classification a hyphen-prefix rule.

* What is drawn on an accent turns by a stated amount, for every accent and both forms (rich-unfiled-791c.0ny5)

Review of the first commit: its test was relational, so losing the lock
everywhere left it green; it named six accents by hand; it read text- only;
and gruvbox's near-grey on-* could not have shown on- at all. TURN is keyed by
AccentRole and states the hue, on a palette whose text- and on- forms are
chromatic.

A role anchors exactly when it names an anchored root, checked over
PALETTE_ROLES: a new drawn-on family would otherwise compile and rotate, which
is this ticket's bug. That replaces the two hand-written isAnchored lists.

Docs: the number of bundled themes was wrong and is gone, and the rule is
stated once as what it is, name syntax.

* Each drawn role is measured against its own hue, and the rule is stated where it lives (rich-unfiled-791c.0ny5)

Medium review: text- was overwritten with the accent, so no real derived value
went through the transposition. Only on- is near grey, so only on- is painted
and each form is compared with its own colour before.

The no-error case pinned a name no role has and read as a second rule beside
the PALETTE_ROLES check, so it is gone. The docs sentence spelling out the
mechanism was a third copy of it; the page already states the family rule by
behaviour, and the transpose.ts header owns the mechanism.

* What is drawn on an accent is measured on a colour with a hue (rich-unfiled-791c.0ny5)

Second high review: gruvbox's text-secondary has chroma near 0.02, so it held
its 2 degree tolerance by 0.18 degrees at a 60 degree key and missed it at 48
other shifts. Both forms now take one chromatic colour stated in the fixture,
unlike any accent; its worst drift over every whole-degree shift is 0.64.

Restores the no-error pin dropped in the previous commit, which was the only
test telling rootOf from a rule that accepts a root in any segment. The
PALETTE_ROLES check speaks for roles and this one for every other name, so
the two do not disagree.
